[[File:Passel_Argente_ROTS.png|thumb|right|250px|Magistrate Passel Argente]]
'''Magistrate''' was a title used to describe a planetary or community head of state as well as the [[Guild Master/Legends|head]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] and its [[Corporate Alliance Directorate|directorate]]. The most well-known Magistrate was [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], who was also a leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Another known Magistrate was [[Kund Ekorr]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].
